subject.title: Upgrade 2026.6.8→2026.6.9 corrupts email channel config with spurious groupAllowFrom field

question: Should core doctor fail closed and skip `groupAllowFrom` writes when it cannot see a channel plugin schema, or should external plugins get an explicit opt-in migration contract first?
rationale: The bug is well supported, but the remaining choice is the compatibility boundary for core-owned repair of external plugin config during upgrade.

options.title: Land Schema-Verified Guard
options.body: Merge the narrow fail-closed guard once normal gates pass, leaving schemaless external channel config untouched by core doctor.

options.title: Add External Opt-In
options.body: Pause the narrow fix and design a plugin doctor/schema capability for external channels that want this migration safely.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Protection
options.body: Use broader config-protection work only if it proves the same email/RCS regression behavior and coverage before replacing the narrow PR.

recommendation.title: Land Schema-Verified Guard
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow fail-closed guard once normal gates pass, leaving schemaless external channel config untouched by core doctor.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the fallback migration being repaired and is the strongest routing signal for the compatibility-boundary decision.
